description: The source reports daily net commuter numbers by census year, municipality and municipal district. It defines the balance as people naming a municipality as their workplace minus people naming it as their residence. Positive balances indicate more workers than resident workers; negative balances indicate the reverse. Native time-span metadata covers 1996–2021, and descriptors list CSV, XLSX, JSON and XML. These are aggregated commuting balances, not origin–destination matrices, trip records or traffic volumes. Exact census years returned, mode shares and commuting distances are not established. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are not established.
